origin.notes: Real RV32IMAC ELF and reports generated with GNU assembler, linker, objdump, and nm. The fixture is intentionally freestanding and links no runtime libraries.
origin.artifactLicense: MIT; generated solely from the included source and linker script with no runtime libraries
origin.provenance: Generated locally from Ubuntu package binutils-riscv64-unknown-elf 2.42-1ubuntu1+6 using the included startup.S and linker.ld.
